question: Before another MRI implementation, is zero-order freezing of the complete effective RHS between physical events even locally close on all60 consumed states of a real125us block?
method: RHS=r*(target-z). At each observed query compare to query0, and separately to first observed query in its physical-event-free interval. Report max over coordinates of h_query*abs(delta RHS)/(3*(atol+rtol*max(abs(z_i),abs(z_anchor)))). This is only a local perturbation proxy, not an integrated error bound.
falsifier: A value>1 invalidates the naive claim that frozen full RHS is always a small perturbation along these observed query states. A value<=1 does not validate a frozen-RHS integrator or MRI correction.
stop_rule: One read-only computation, no selected rank/anchor tuning. Keep MRI with recurrent correction separate from naive freezing.
